prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean an indoor UV/bed salon or a spray (sunless) tan? And do you have a preferred neighborhood or ZIP code in Columbus (Downtown, Ohio State area, Westerville, Dublin, Grove City, etc.)?

I don’t have real‑time web access in this session, but I can:
- Give tailored guidance on how to pick the best salon,
- Tell you what to look for in reviews and prices,
- Or, if you want, I can look up current top-rated salons and their hours/addresses if you give me permission to fetch live information (and tell me the neighborhood or ZIP).

Quick tips to find the best salon right now
- Decide spray vs UV: spray/sunless is much safer (no UV exposure). If you want a natural, even result, choose a salon with certified technicians and before/after photos.
- Check recent reviews on Google, Yelp, and Facebook (last 6–12 months matter most).
- Look for cleanliness, staff professionalism, photos of the space/equipment, and mentions of patch tests or allergy questions for spray tans.
- For spray tans: ask whether they use booth systems or technician-applied solution (tech-applied tends to be more even), which brand (e.g., Versa, Mystic), and about color customization.
- For UV tanning: verify bed age and maintenance, and whether they follow safety limits and client skin-type assessments. Consider avoiding UV altogether if possible.
- Ask about pricing transparently (session cost, packages/memberships, cancellation policy) and whether they offer a patch test for spray tans.

If you tell me the type of tanning you want and your area, I’ll either give a short list of likely top options (and I can pull up live info if you want). Which would you prefer?
